summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting transactions under its ongoing share repurchase programme initiated 6 May 2026, part of an up-to-DKK 15 billion programme announced 4 February 2026. The filing details daily B-share buybacks from 18-22 May 2026 at an average price of approximately DKK 287 per share, with accumulated transactions of 2,289,849 B shares for DKK 670,560,306. As of 22 May, total repurchases since programme start were 17,049,028 B shares at DKK 4,470,560,295. This represents routine capital return activity, not a special situation event, as it is a scheduled open-market buyback under safe harbour regulations.
